section.content: The invention provides a biogenic sample storage device. The biogenic sample storage device comprises a cuboid box body, a box cover hinged to the box body and a seal cover; the box body comprises an inner wall, an outer wall and a heat preservation layer arranged between the inner wall and the outer wall, a buffer pad is fixedly arranged in the box body, a plurality o storage grooves are formed in the buffer pad, and the seal cover comprises a cover plate and seal blocks which are arranged at the bottom of the cover plate and are in one-to-one correspondence to the storage grooves, the four top corners of the bottom of the seal cover are each provided with a fixed bolt, an elastic spring sleeve is arranged at the position, corresponding to each fixed bolt, between the inner wall and the outer wall of the box body, and the fixed bolts are inserted into the elastic spring sleeves to achieve connection of the seal cover and the box body. The box body is composed of the inner wall, the outer wall and a foam layer arranged between the inner wall and the outer wall, the good heat preservation effect is achieved, and activity of biogenic samples can be maintained.

本发明提供种生物基因样本存储装置，包括长方体型的箱体、与箱体铰接的箱盖及密封盖；箱体包括内壁、外壁及设置在内壁和外壁之间的保温层，箱体内部固定设置有缓冲垫，缓冲垫上开设有若干存储槽；密封盖包括盖板和设置在盖板底部且与存储槽对应的密封块，密封盖底部四个顶角处各设置个固定栓，箱体的内壁和外壁之间与固定栓对应的位置设置有弹性簧套，固定栓插入弹性簧套中实现密封盖与箱体的连接。本发明箱体由内壁、外壁及设置在内壁和外壁之间的泡沫层，具有很好的保温效果，可以保持生物基因样本的活性。

A kind of biological gene sample storage deviceTechnical field

Present invention relates particularly to a kind of biological gene sample storage device.

Background technology

With the development of biotechnology, people often use the device stored to biological specimen.Existing storage Device poor thermal insulation property, biological gene sample may lose activity during transfer.

The content of the invention

The purpose of the present invention is to solve the shortcomings of the prior art, there is provided a kind of biological gene sample storage device, the life Thing cdna sample storage device can solve the above problems well.

To reach above-mentioned requirements, the present invention is adopted the technical scheme that：A kind of biological gene sample storage device is provided, should Biological gene sample storage device includes the case lid and closure that the casing and casing of cuboid-type are hinged；Casing include inwall, Outer wall and setting heat-insulation layer between the inner walls and the outer, box house is fixedly installed cushion pad, if being offered on cushion pad Dry holding tank；Closure include cover plate and be arranged on cover plate bottom and with the one-to-one sealing block of holding tank, closure bottom One gim peg is respectively set at four drift angles, and position corresponding with gim peg sets flexible spring between the inner and outer wall of casing Set, realizes the connection of closure and casing in the elastic spring set of gim peg insertion.

The biological gene sample storage device has the advantage that as follows：

（1）Casing is by inwall, outer wall and sets froth bed between the inner walls and the outer, with good heat insulation effect, can be with Keep the activity of biological gene sample.

（2）Closure is set on casing, and the sealing block on closure forms a sealing with the holding tank on cushion pad Memory space, it is to avoid the test tube equipped with biological gene sample is at random.

（3）Cushion pad and sealing block are made by rubber, can reduce the impact to test tube in transfer process, it is to avoid damage Test tube.
